evidence: Cic. Ac. 2.3: tōtīus bellī īnstrūmentum et apparātus (Lewis & Short)
terms.comment: First the getting ready; then all that is got ready for an undertaking, its gear (with īnstrūmentum in Cicero). Also pomp, splendour.

sources: Descriptions and prompts labelled as ours are composed for family conversation. Recorded vocabulary does not imply universal technical standardization.
